tasks.label: simulate-telegram-webhook-query
tasks.command: $chatId = (docker exec vault_db psql -U admin -d initial_db -At -c "SELECT value FROM system_settings WHERE key='TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID' LIMIT 1;").Trim(); $payload = @{ message = @{ text = 'Can you tell me last months total grocery expense?'; chat = @{ id = [int64]$chatId } } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://nonpharmaceutical-charlena-vulpine.ngrok-free.dev/api/telegram/webhook" -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" -Body $payload | Select-Object StatusCode,StatusDescription
